## Developer Guide

If you are new to using `nbdev` here are some useful pointers to get you
started.

### Install tripathysagar.github.io in Development mode

``` sh
# make sure tripathysagar.github.io package is installed in development mode
$ pip install -e .

# make changes under nbs/ directory
# ...

# compile to have changes apply to tripathysagar.github.io
$ nbdev_prepare
```

## Usage

### Installation

Install latest from the GitHub
[repository](https://github.com/tripathysagar/tripathysagar.github.io):

``` sh
$ pip install git+https://github.com/tripathysagar/tripathysagar.github.io.git
```

or from
[conda](https://anaconda.org/tripathysagar/tripathysagar.github.io)

``` sh
$ conda install -c tripathysagar tripathysagar.github.io
```

or from [pypi](https://pypi.org/project/tripathysagar.github.io/)

``` sh
$ pip install tripathysagar.github.io
```

### Documentation
